jojo_ripples.skill.hp_vine.desc: Use Hermit Spider as a whip to attack your enemies, you can infuse it hamon if you have learned hamon infusion
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_grab.desc: Use Hermit Spider as a whip to grab your enemies
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_vine_heavy.desc: Use Hermit Spider as a whip to perform an strong attack to your enemies with a low chance of disarming their offhand or the main hand, you can infuse it hamon if you have learned hamon infusion
jojo_ripples.skill.cringe.desc: Deal emotional damage to your opponent
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_doxx.desc: Exposes the target location into a map, you should have the map in the off-hand
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_doxx.controls: Special ability, Shift to increase the map Zoom
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_target.desc: Opens a menu that let you select an specific target to use the spirit divination.
jojo_ripples.skill.hp_block.desc: It protects you from any contact damage that isn't a projectile
